findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - the rules suite classifies the member removal guide test.
The added label is `FORGE-MAIL-1/GUIDE`, whereas the Done-when requires `FORGE-MAIL-1`. `tests/test_rules.py:31–35` reads the constant verbatim and line 51 uses that exact string as the criterion namespace, so these labels are distinct. The reported four passing tests establish uniqueness but do not establish the required label. Set this constant to `FORGE-MAIL-1`.
